sections.overview: Sommeromys macrorhinos is a little-known murid rodent endemic to the central highlands of Sulawesi, Indonesia.
sections.identification: Its notably elongated snout and slender build distinguish the genus from many other Sulawesi murids.
sections.habitat: It has been recorded in tropical montane forest between 1600 and 2600 metres.
sections.diet: The available species account describes it as insectivorous.
sections.behavior: It is nocturnal and uses both the ground and vegetation.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted provide no detailed account of its reproduction.
sections.ecology: It is known from only a few mountain localities, and further surveys are needed to clarify its range and ecology.
sections.conservation: The Mammal Diversity Database reports the latest global IUCN category as Near Threatened.
